commands.command:
set -e; EXPECTED=60cbe81af2e02ba2e4100691c8afb76332735548; git fetch origin work/phase1-live-call-probes; git checkout work/phase1-live-call-probes; git reset --hard origin/work/phase1-live-call-probes; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d ''); echo call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$'; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/dev/null; for I in 1 2 3; do echo offcall_iteration=$I; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; START=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.DiagnosticProbeActivity --ez run_shizuku_probe true 2>&1); printf '%s
' "$START"; printf '%s
' "$START" | grep -q 'Status: ok'; sleep 4; LOG=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S'); printf '%s
' "$LOG"; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'shizuku_probe_start=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'service_uid=2000'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'prepared_after_prepare=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'prepared_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'active_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'privileged_uid=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'offcall_parity_ok=true'; done; echo phase2_m3_offcall_parity_green=true
